description: CRE Technology Gensys Compact series genset controllers. Covers Compact AMF (A56-AMF), Compact PRIME (A56-PRIME), and Compact MAINS (A56-MAINS) variants in both -00 and -10 hardware revisions.
notes: Holding register access. 32-bit registers use little-endian word order (low word first). Serial number is derived from identification registers 4-6 encoding production week, year, and sequence number. Active power registers 363-365 have variable scaling based on nominal genset power (register 2105): the power unit is 10^floor(log10(nominal_kW)). For example, a 100 kW genset uses a power unit of 100 W. Fuel tank readings are not supported as there is no reliable way to detect if a fuel sensor is connected via Modbus (firmware v2.40). Register barriers at addresses 77, 360-362, 4002-4005 prevent contiguous reads across those boundaries.

identification.description: Device identification. Register 4: digit 0=platform type (0=Compact/56, 1=Enhanced/66), digits 1-2=production week, digits 3-4=production year. Register 6: digits 0-1=product family code, digits 2-4=production number.

ac_energy_forward.description: Total generated energy. 32-bit little-endian word order.

engine_operating_hours.description: Total engine operating hours. Raw value in hours, multiply by 3600 for seconds. 32-bit little-endian word order.

engine_oil_pressure.description: Engine oil pressure. Raw value multiplied by 10 for kPa.

ac_l1_power.description: Generator L1 phase active power. Scale factor is variable based on nominal genset power (register 2105). Power unit = 10^floor(log10(nominal_kW)) watts.

ac_l2_power.description: Generator L2 phase active power. Scale factor is variable, see ac_l1_power.

ac_l3_power.description: Generator L3 phase active power. Scale factor is variable, see ac_l1_power.

ac_total_power.description: Generator total active power. Scale factor is variable, see ac_l1_power.

nominal_power.description: Nominal genset power in kW. Used to calculate power register scaling: power_unit = 10^floor(log10(value)).

status_code.description: Engine status code: 0=Waiting, 2=Start, 3=Warm-up, 4=Ck speed stab, 5=Ck volt stab, 6=GE ready, 7=Opening GE, 8=Cool down, 9=Stop, 11=Rest, 12=Pre-Start, 13=Wait other eng, 14=Closing GE, 20=Starter only, 21=Ignition ON, 22=Start, 23=Ignition only, 40=Ext start seq, 255=Fault

operating_mode.description: Operating mode: 0=MAN, 1=TEST, 2=AUTO. Remote start enabled when mode is AUTO (2).

remote_start_on_load.description: Remote start on load command. Write 1 to start generator in automatic mode and close generator breaker. Write 0 to stop.

set_auto_mode.description: Set controller to AUTO mode. Write 1 to activate.

alarm_status.description: Alarm status registers. Register 4664 word 0: shutdown alarm active (nonzero = error). Register 4664 word 1: warning alarm active (nonzero = warning).
